subject.title: feat(feishu): pass through form_value, input_value, option(s) from card actions

question: What should the agent-visible payload contract be when a Feishu card action carries both command/text data and form/select callback fields?
rationale: The PR introduces a new synthetic-message payload shape and current main already has structured card-action routing, so maintainers need to choose the compatibility contract before automation can safely repair or merge it.

options.title: Command-first additive contract
options.body: Preserve existing `text`/`command` dispatch and add form/select data through a documented additive representation so existing cards keep working while new data reaches agents.

options.title: Structured JSON text contract
options.body: Adopt the PR's JSON text payload shape for form/select callbacks and accept that agents may need to parse a new message format.

options.title: Typed channel action contract
options.body: Defer this PR and design a typed card-action payload surface instead of encoding the extra data into synthetic text.

recommendation.title: Command-first additive contract
recommendation.body: Preserve existing `text`/`command` dispatch and add form/select data through a documented additive representation so existing cards keep working while new data reaches agents.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision intersects the structured Feishu card-action routing introduced in the interactive approval flow work.
